description: Lines progressively shorter or longer within each block creating a visual staircase effect
example_correct: Line one is the longest in this block.\nThen it gets shorter.\nLike this.
example_wrong: All lines are the same length in every block which creates a wall of text that is hard to scan and feels monotonous.

description: No more than 3 consecutive lines without a blank line separating blocks
example_correct:
First line of thought.
Second line.
Third line.

New block starts here.
example_wrong:
Line one.
Line two.
Line three.
Line four.
Line five.
Line six without any break.

description: Do not use bold italic or underline formatting. Use UPPERCASE sparingly for emphasis on headers only.
example_correct: THE REAL LESSON\n\nHere's what I learned from that experience.
example_wrong: **The Real Lesson**\n\n*Here's* what I __learned__ from that experience.

description: Replace em dashes and en dashes with full stops and commas instead
example_correct: I was tired. Really tired. But I kept going.
example_wrong: I was tired — really tired — but I kept going.

description: Bullets should use space-hyphen-space format not underscores or other symbols
example_correct: - First point\n - Second point\n - Third point

description: Numbered lists should use simple digit-period-space format
example_correct: 1. First item\n2. Second item\n3. Third item
example_wrong: 1) First item\n2) Second item\n3) Third item

description: Sequential flows should use arrow format with spaces
example_wrong: A->B->C->D or A → B → C → D

description: Maximum 3 emojis per post placed only at points of maximum emotional tension or buildup
example_correct: Long post with no emojis until... 🔥 the key insight drops.
example_wrong: 🚀 Hey everyone! 👋 Today I want to share 💡 my thoughts on 🎯 product management 📊 and why 🔥 it matters 🙏

description: Write at FK Grade 7 readability level. Ad copy style with layman language and no jargon.
example_correct: I talked to 50 users. Most said the same thing. The feature was confusing.
example_wrong: I conducted 50 user interviews to synthesize qualitative feedback indicating suboptimal UX affordances.

description: Posts should be 800-1600 ASCII characters in length
example_correct: A well-structured post between 800 and 1600 characters that covers one idea clearly.
example_wrong: A 200-character post that says nothing or a 3000-character essay that loses the reader.

description: After CTA the first footer line should be a positioning statement — who you are and the value you provide
example_correct: PM by day. Builder by night. Writing about what I learn.

description: After the positioning line add a follow invitation line
example_correct: Follow for weekly PM insights and career stories.
example_wrong: Please like share and subscribe to my newsletter and also check out my website.

description: 3-6 generic hashtags placed only at the very end of the post. Never in the body text.
example_wrong: I love #ProductManagement because it lets me work on #Startup ideas in my #Career

description: Each post should focus on exactly one core idea or takeaway
example_correct: One post about one lesson from one experience with one clear takeaway.
example_wrong: A post that covers 5 different topics jumping from career advice to tool reviews to personal stories.

description: Use generous whitespace between blocks to create visual breathing room on mobile
example_wrong: Short line. Another thought. Key point here. All cramped together in a single block.
